title: Economics study_design contract v1
description: Contract produced by the Economics Research Director (domain-level scientific controller) and consumed by the Core Coordinator. Structural contract only: it validates shape/enum/registry membership. It does NOT resolve capabilities, decide unresolved scientific questions, or gate admission.

domain.description: Domain pack id. Only 'economics' is valid for this contract.

mode.description: Execution mode recognized by the resolver. 'production' enforces strict admission; 'test' allows the test-mode policy.

allow_experimental.description: Whether test/experimental implementations may be admitted in non-production modes.

approved_overrides.description: Run-level explicit approvals (capability + implementation). Never bypasses high-risk production verified-only admission.

selected_capabilities.description: Mapping role id -> array of capability ids (resolver-compatible representation).

decisions.description: Structured scientific decisions. Method-specific fields (e.g. instrument, family_definition) are NOT globally required; they are capability/precondition-specific.

preconditions.description: Structured machine-checkable / manual preconditions (e.g. design.panel, design.treatment_timing).
